description: Returns one programme of the index in detail. Residency programmes: minimum amount and investment options, physical presence, time to permanent residency and to citizenship, dual citizenship, settlement area, tax system of the country, steps and excerpts of the GoodbyeMatrix programme texts (overview, qualification, costs, benefits, citizenship timeline, legal basis). Citizenship by investment programmes: routes with starting amounts, visa-free destinations, status (cost calculator, on request, coming soon or closed) and official links. Includes the programme page in German and English, the date of the source and consultationNote. Read-only: it only retrieves and computes from the GoodbyeMatrix data set, stores nothing, sends nothing and calls no external services.

id.description: Programme id from search_programs or get_country_overview, or a programme name (word order and country codes are tolerated).

name: get_program

candidates.description: Only when the name matches several programmes: up to 5 matching programmes with their ids.

cbiQuoteNote.description: Only for the 9 programmes with a cost calculator: get_cbi_quote calculates the costs for a specific family.

notice.description: General information, not legal, tax or immigration advice.

program.description: The programme; null when the name matches several programmes (see candidates).

availability.description: Citizenship by investment only: cost_calculator, on_request, coming_soon or closed.

id.description: Programme id for get_program and compare_programs.

incomeRequirement.description: Residency only, where published: minimum income as on the programme page.

minInvestmentUsd.description: Minimum investment in USD where known (0 when no investment is required).

minimumAmount.description: Minimum investment as published on the programme page (currency as stated); for citizenship by investment the lowest starting amount in USD.

yearsToCitizenship.description: Shortest published number of years to citizenship.

yearsToCitizenshipText.description: Published wording when the years to citizenship depend on nationality or other conditions.

title: Get programme details
